maddeler.e:
انشرحت (form VII)
# اِنْشَرَحْتُ (inšaraḥtu) /in.ʃa.raħ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# اِنْشَرَحْتَ (inšaraḥta) /in.ʃa.raħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# اِنْشَرَحْتِ (inšaraḥti) /in.ʃa.raħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْشَرَحَ (inšaraḥa)
# اِنْشَرَحَتْ (inšaraḥat) /in.ʃa.ra.ħat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
